font_embedding.description: Whether to embed fonts in generated PDFs (helpful for font portability)

font_dir.description: Directory containing fonts available for embedding

ghostscript_path.description: Full path to the Ghostscript binary

ghostscript_options.description: Additional options passed to Ghostscript (avoid unsafe overrides like -dNOPROMPT)

max_filter_processes.description: Maximum number of concurrent filter worker processes

default_raster_format.description: Raster format to use for PDF-to-raster conversion (e.g., auto, rgb, cmyk, gray)

ipp_everywhere.description: Enable IPP Everywhere compliance, including fallback defaults for media and color

ppd_path.description: Directory where PPD files for legacy drivers are stored

pdf_optimize.description: Strip unused objects and optimize PDFs before printing

pdf_rendering_engine.description: PDF rendering engine to use; choose ghostscript, poppler, or qpdf

raster_dpi_list.description: List of DPI resolutions used during raster conversion fallback

http_proxy_host.description: HTTP proxy hostname/IP for network printer discovery (optional)

http_proxy_port.description: HTTP proxy port (used only if http_proxy_host is set)

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: error, warn, info, or debug

log_path.description: Path to the cups-filters log file; empty string means syslog only

extra_mime_types.description: Additional MIME types to support (e.g., for vendor-specific filters)

app_type.description: MIME type or application type (e.g., application/pdf)

filter.description: Path or name of filter binary to invoke (e.g., pdftopdf)

priority.description: Priority of this mapping; lower numbers have higher precedence

filter_mappings.description: Custom mapping from input types to filters (e.g., legacy driver support)

filter_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a filter before failing the job

color_management.description: Enable ICC-based color management for color-critical printing

icc_profile_paths.description: Directories to search for ICC profiles

default_rgb_profile.description: Default ICC profile for RGB output; can be a known name or full path

default_cmyk_profile.description: Default ICC profile for CMYK output; common names: Coated_FOGRA27, SWOP_Coated
